template: Prohibition on discrimination against recipients of public assistance or housing subsidies (source of income) applies to this address. Source: M.G.L. c. 151B, § 4(10); as of 2026-01-02. Not legal advice.
rewrite: At this address, it is against the law to discriminate against people because they receive public assistance or housing subsidies (their source of income). Source: M.G.L. c. 151B, § 4(10), as of 2026-01-02. Not legal advice.
